signals.title: Road safety police in Cornwall report 155mph motorcycle speeding offence
signals.summary: A motorcyclist has been caught speeding on a dual carriageway in Cornwall at more than twice the speed limit. A motorcyclist in the UK is set for a court hearing after being caught speeding at more than double the speed limit on a dual carriageway. The incident took place on May 30, 2026, when the motorcyclist was caught doing 155mph in a 70 zone. The speeding offence was reported by the Devon and Cornwall Police Road Safety Team, which says more information regarding the outcome of the court hearing will be provided in “due course”. By travelling at 155mph, the rider not only put his own life at risk, but also the lives of other road users around him. The rider can be seen doing these reckless speeds while overtaking cars on the inside lane, on what seems to be a 60th Grand Prix Anniversary Yamaha supersport. Hitting such speeds means the motorcycle rider was likely covering the distance of a full size football pitch in roughly 1.5 seconds. That’s the same amount of time that the average road user takes before they begin reacting to a hazard, according to the safety team. A social media post from the Devon and Cornwall Police Road Safety Team said this about the speeding offence: “The summer months, dry weather, longer evenings and sunny days create great conditions for getting out and enjoying a ride on your motorcycle. signals.title: MCL is giving away a one-off custom helmet – and it couldn’t be easier to enter!
signals.summary: MCL26 is giving riders the chance to win a one-off custom-painted helmet while celebrating every corner of the biking community. Be you an adventure rider, racer, custom builder or commuter, there is one thing that connects us all under one roof – we start a ride the same way, by pulling on a helmet. That's the thinking behind MCL’s latest RideTribe campaign, which is celebrating the diversity of the UK motorcycle community, by giving one lucky rider the chance to win a unique, custom-painted helmet at MCL26. The competition centres around a one-off helmet, created by the renowned lid painter RichArt. It is based on a Arai RX-7V Evo helmet, which is widely regarded as a benchmark in motorcycle helmet technology. Making the one-off piece all the more rare is what will happen to it in the run up to the show. It’s set to begin a UK-wide tour, where it will be signed by riding celebrities and racing royalty, making it totally one of a kind. To be in with a chance of winning the stunning looking lid, entering is easy. Dotted around the NEC will be QR codes. Simply head to MCL26, scan one of the QR codes and follow the instructions – it really couldn’t be any simpler. It's a fitting build-up to MCL26, which returns to Birmingham's NEC from 21 to 29 November. As ever, the show promises the latest motorcycles from the world's biggest manufacturers, opportunities to test ride new machines, riding experiences for newcomers, live entertainment and halls packed with the latest riding kit

signals.title: Is “The Goat” concept actually going to be an adventure bike?
signals.summary: A new Buell hill climber concept, which is based off one of the American company’s early Super Cruiser prototypes, could soon be heading for production as an adventure motorcycle. It looks as though Buell Motorcycle’ flagship Super Cruiser could be about to serve as inspiration for a new adventure motorcycle in the near future. This is after a Buell “The Goat” hill climber concept was revealed, and while not all concept motorcycles head for production, it’s clear that by using the Super Cruiser as its base, the American brand could at least be considering it. According to Hot Bike, the new concept was built as a hill climber to test how versatile Buell’s Super Cruiser motorcycle platform is. A post shared by Hot Bike Magazine (@hotbikemag) The bike makes use of long-travel WP suspension, and a stripped-down chassis, which in-turn has led to an aggressive-looking two-way exhaust system. The report goes on to say that, according to Buell CEO Bill Melvin, discussions to adapt the platform into an adventure-based motorcycle have already taken place with the team that was in charge of the project. Photos of the bike show the brand’s Super Cruiser wearing knobbly off-road-focused tyres, which is one of the most evident and significant adjustments made from the standard model in road trim. signals.title: Ducati secures major research and development investment fund
signals.summary: Despite ongoing rumours of the company potentially being sold, Ducati is set to strengthen its research and development capabilities through a new €121m investment fund. Ducati has secured a €121m (around £104m) investment fund to strengthen competitiveness, innovation and growth through its new project, ‘Ducati Raise the Bar’. Ducati says the new programme will focus heavily on the company’s R&D (Research and Development) sector, as well as technical innovation. The Ministry of Enterprises and Made in Italy authorised the new agreement, according to Ducati, which includes a non-repayable grant from the Ministry of €33.5m, which converts to roughly £28.7m. This means that just over 25 per cent of the programme will be funded by the government ministry. What all of this indicates is that Ducati, despite ongoing rumours of the company being sold by current owners Volkswagen AG, is set to invest heavily in the development of future motorcycles, its racing programmes, and the company’s wider business operations. At the heart of Ducati’s new programme will be “industrial research and experimental development”, with the Bologna-based company allocating €99m (around £85m) to this particular sector. Alongside the research and development plan, which Ducati hopes will strengthen its position as one of the biggest motorcycle brands in the world, the programme is also about contributing to local areas in Italy. signals.title: Mad Dogs biker gang leader speaks out after M74 motorway ambush
signals.summary: 63-year-old motorcyclist, Mark 'Bruni' Brown - president of the Mad Dogs Motorcycle Club in Scotland, remains in hospital after an attack was carried out by 12 alleged armed individuals on the M74 motorway. Mark 'Bruni' Brown, president of the Mad Dogs biker gang in Scotland, remains in hospital with serious injuries after a targeted attack was carried out by armed individuals on the M74 motorway. The incident happened at around 1pm on Sunday, August 2, between junctions 10 and 11 near Lesmahagow, when emergency services were called to reports of a disturbance involving a group of motorcyclists and people travelling in four vehicles. The 63-year-old rider, along with other members of the club, was ambushed by the masked attackers who exited their vehicles with swords and bats, according to a report from the Daily Record. Brown suffered serious injuries as a result, but has vowed to fight on in a social media post that has since been deleted. Brown said this as part of the social media update: “A bit of background to what has been going on with the dogs. This is NOT rumours or bulls***, just straight facts. “To set it straight YES we were attacked on the M74 motorway by 12 masked and heavily armed cowardly cardboard gangster puppets with swords, bats and anything they could grab as a weapon. “Here’s their version, ‘We are all in hospital and some of us are dead’. signals.title: Hasil Klasemen Moto3 2026, Veda Ega Pratama Bertahan di Posisi 6
signals.summary: Hasil Klasemen Moto3 2026, Veda Ega Pratama Bertahan di Posisi 6 JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com - Pebalap Indonesia, Veda Ega Pratama, berhasil mempertahankan posisi keenam klasemen sementara Moto3 2026 setelah menjalani balapan utama Moto3 Inggris di Sirkuit Silverstone, Minggu (9/8/2026). Pebalap asal Gunung Kidul, Yogyakarta, tersebut finis di posisi kesembilan pada balapan Moto3 Inggris. Hasil itu membuat Veda mendapatkan tambahan tujuh poin. Kini, Veda Ega Pratama mengoleksi 97 poin di klasemen sementara Moto3 2026 bersama Honda Team Asia. Baca juga: Hasil Moto3 Inggris 2026: Almanza Juara, Veda Ega Pratama Finis ke 9 Veda Ega Pratama tampil cukup konsisten pada Moto3 Inggris 2026 . Meski belum berhasil naik ke posisi lebih tinggi, hasil finis sembilan besar membuatnya tetap berada dalam persaingan papan atas. Sebelum balapan Inggris, Veda mengoleksi 90 poin. Tambahan tujuh poin dari Silverstone membuat perolehan poinnya bertambah menjadi 97 poin. Pebalap muda itu kini berada di belakang David Almansa yang menempati posisi kelima dengan 134 poin. Dok. Honda Team Asia Veda Ega Pratama saat balapan pada Moto3 Belanda 2026 Moto3 Inggris menjadi balapan yang menguntungkan bagi beberapa pebalap papan atas. David Almansa berhasil meraih kemenangan di Silverstone dan mendapatkan tambahan 25 poin. signals.title: Penjualan Hybrid Naik 45 Persen, Gaikindo Masih Minta Insentif
signals.summary: Penjualan Hybrid Naik 45 Persen, Gaikindo Masih Minta Insentif JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com - Gabungan Industri Kendaraan Bermotor Indonesia (Gaikindo) berharap pemerintah kembali memberikan stimulus untuk kendaraan berteknologi hybrid. Permintaan tersebut muncul di tengah tren penjualan mobil hybrid yang terus menunjukkan pertumbuhan. Namun demikian, pemerintah justru memberikan sinyal bahwa insentif tambahan untuk mobil hybrid belum menjadi prioritas. Vice Chairman Market Development Gaikindo Jongkie D. Sugiarto mengatakan, sepintas memang kelihatannya penjualan mobil hybrid cukup positif.
